shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic representation (arm/hand on A; standing figures on B)
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces reduce the human body to a highly schematic sign 	he pillar's carved arm and splayed hand, and the two stick-like silhouetted figures with blob heads 	hough these are quite different kinds of abstraction. Otherwise the content diverges completely: A shows a quadruped in relief descending a tall vertical anthropomorphic shaft, while B shows a horizontal boat with upturned prow and stern carrying two standing crew, a scene with no counterpart in A.
